calibration_derivation.alternative_success_probability: calibration fraction alternative mean balanced accuracy >= 0.97
calibration_derivation.conditional_direct_remaining: median(direct total_runtime_s - checkpoint) among calibration rows whose direct total_runtime_s exceeds checkpoint
calibration_derivation.conditional_direct_success_probability: eligible fraction with direct total_runtime_s <= deadline_s and direct mean balanced accuracy >= 0.97
calibration_derivation.freeze_rule: Persist calibration raw JSONL and derived snapshot, hash both, commit/read back both before measuring any confirmation seed.
calibration_derivation.switch_rule: alternative utility > 1.10 * direct utility at two consecutive checkpoints AND checkpoint + alternative_runtime + switch_cost <= deadline

candidate_rule.failure_rule: Report failure as-is; do not retune on seeds 9100..9117.
forecast_qc: abs(confirmation direct success - calibration predicted direct success) <= 0.20
confirmation direct runtime coverage by calibration direct p90 >= 0.80
conditional remaining-cost MAE at second checkpoint <= 0.35 * deadline

legacy_confirmation_quarantine.reason: The sequence-104 precommit depended on exact calibration raw traces and a versioned harness that are absent at the frozen repository SHA.
legacy_confirmation_quarantine.rule: Do not consume or reuse these seeds in this repaired study.

measurement_protocol.fold_timing: time.perf_counter around fit+predict for each fold; total runtime is sum of 3 fold runtimes
measurement_protocol.raw_row_persistence: canonical sorted-key compact JSONL; append one row per seed; flush+fsync after each row

policy_simulation.conditional_reforecast: same using frozen switch_at_s from calibration snapshot; no confirmation-derived threshold changes
policy_simulation.direct_only: observed direct total runtime and direct quality
policy_simulation.fixed_cap: if direct total exceeds fixed cap and cap+switch_cost+observed alternative runtime fits deadline, use alternative outcome; otherwise direct

purpose: Repair sequence-104 replay-completeness defect with a fully fresh calibration+confirmation study whose executable harness and rules are durable before any model timing measurement.
sealing_order: commit+readback snapshot and raw/snapshot digest manifest
checkpoint sequence and role-local execution receipt
